structureTitle.context: Insights: title of the card with the donut of the selected month's spending by category.

structureHeadline.context: Insights > spending structure card: sentence above the donut. {name} is the biggest category, {share} its percentage like '34%', {month} the month's name alone.

share.context: Insights > spending structure and top categories: table header, a category's percentage of the month's spending.

topTitle.context: Insights: title of the card listing the month's three biggest spending categories.

topHeadline.context: Insights > top categories card: sentence above the list. {share} is the percentage like '62%' the listed categories make together.

topTypical.context: Insights > top categories: under a category in the running month, what it usually costs. {amount} is formatted money.

topMore.context: Insights > top categories: a finished month's category cost more than its average of the months before. {amount} is formatted money.

topLess.context: Insights > top categories: a finished month's category cost less than its average of the months before. {amount} is formatted money.

topAsUsual.context: Insights > top categories: a finished month's category cost within 10% of its average of the months before.

topNoTypical.context: Insights > top categories: no earlier months to compare a category with.

typical.context: Insights > top categories: table header, average of the up to three months before.
